shortDescription: Collects Fibre Channel adapter statistics using the fcstat command on AIX

options.name: all_statistics
options.description: Displays all statistics, including device-specific statistics (-e).

options.name: concatenated_output
options.description: Controls whether the output is appended to the file or overwrites it.

options.name: count
options.description: Number of reports to generate at the specified interval. Must be used together with the interval option.

options.name: device_name
options.description: Name of the Fibre Channel device (for example, fcs0).

options.name: interval
options.description: Displays a time-series report of the traffic statistics continuously with a time interval between two consecutive reports,. If set to 0, only a single report is generated.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Displays a time-series report of traffic statistics for a specific transport protocol (TP) that is specified with the Protocol parameter.

options.name: recorded_output
options.description: Path to file where command output should be written.

options.name: remove_delay
options.description: Removes delay in generating output when the device is opened in nondiagnostic mode and the link is down.

options.name: reset_stats
options.description: Resets some statistics back to initial values (-z). Only privileged users can issue this flag.
